issues.title: Canonical duplicate key omits position strata and can delete legitimate distributions
issues.defect: The empirical distribution identity explicitly includes `position_field` and `position_value`, but the pre-emission canonical duplicate key omits both. Distinct position-stratified distributions can therefore collide before atom creation.
issues.evidence: Constructed rows identical except for position stratum produced the same canonical duplicate key but different `empirical_distribution_id` values.
issues.consequence: Legitimate stratified evidence can disappear silently, corrupting coverage, atom counts, and downstream structural analysis.
issues.required: Make deduplication identity at least as discriminating as the empirical distribution identity. Include position_field/value and any other identity fields required by the canonical distribution contract; assert no distinct distribution IDs are dropped as duplicates.
tests: Two rows differing only by position stratum survive as distinct candidates/distributions.
Deduplication cannot collapse distinct empirical_distribution_id values.
